description: This Java class `RegisterSurveyCommandHandler` implements a command handler for registering surveys within the Apache Fineract project. It acts as a service component that processes commands related to survey registration, delegating the actual registration logic to the `WriteSurveyService`. The handler is wired via dependency injection and is transactional.

classes.name: RegisterSurveyCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component that handles survey registration commands, delegating the process to WriteSurveyService, and managing transactions.

methods.name: RegisterSurveyCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the WriteSurveyService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the survey registration command by delegating to WriteSurveyService's registerSurvey method.
